title: Zesty Nutty Saudi Arabian Chinese Cabbage Kebabs
description: A unique fusion dish featuring Chinese cabbage, nutty flavors, and a hint of Saudi Arabian spice, perfect for a date night, this halal-friendly recipe combines the freshness of Chinese cabbage with the richness of nuts and the depth of kombu-cold-extract.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
Thread the Chinese cabbage, almonds, and pine nuts onto skewers.
In a bowl, whisk together the kombu-cold-extract, olive oil, salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander.
Brush the mixture onto the kebabs.
Grill the kebabs for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
In a small bowl, mix together the pomegranate molasses and 1 tablespoon of water.
Brush the pomegranate glaze onto the kebabs during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional toasted pine nuts and almonds if desired.
